item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is describing the position of her school library to her friend Ravi. She says, "The library is 20 m from the main gate."

Which statement about Meena's description is correct?

options.A: The main gate is the reference point because the distance is measured from it.
options.B: The library is the reference point because its position is being described.
options.C: No reference point is needed because the distance is only 20 m.
options.D: Ravi's house is the reference point because he is listening to the description.
